- The submission needs at least one peer and requires a number in every peer field. I could not fix the first without breaking the rules on the second. My first attempt, with UPS alone, failed for lack of a peer. My second, with the peers left as "not found", failed because nulls aren't allowed.

**UPS (USD, millions, FY2025 ended 31 Dec 2025)**

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 88,661 | UPS 10-K, accession 0001628280-26-008432 |
| Operating profit | 7,867 | Same 10-K |

| Cash and equivalents | 5,887 | Same 10-K |
| Net debt | 17,459 | Debt minus cash |
| Market cap | about 97,250 | TradingView snapshot, undated |

- **Debt split:** I haven't checked the stockanalysis.com debt split against the 10-K debt note. The 10-K's own lines include finance leases (608 current and 23,519 long-term).
- **Fiscal year:** search results also showed UPS figures through mid-2026. I used FY2025 because it is the last full-year 10-K I could cite.

**Peers I intended to use**
- FedEx (FDX, USD)
- Deutsche Post DHL (DHL.DE, EUR)
- J.B. Hunt (JBHT, USD)
- XPO (XPO, USD)

None of these has any figures. Before filling them in, check which fiscal year each has last filed. FedEx's year ends in May, so its latest 10-K may be FY2026 rather than FY2025.
